<thought>We need to apply the nitro‑to‑amine retrosynthetic template (ID 84231) to the target molecule(s). The target list from the previous step contains two SMILES; only the first one, “CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1”, has an aromatic primary amine that matches the template. Applying the template retro‑actively will give the nitro‑precursor for that fragment. The second SMILES does not match the template, so it yields no precursors. The required output is a list of lists, each inner list containing the SMILES of the precursor(s) for each applicable product. The apply_template tool will generate the needed precursor(s).</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1", "template_id": "84231"}</action_input>
